name: Can-Am X3 Turbo RR - 4 Seater
blurb: Four seats behind the most powerful X3 setup we run.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Can-Am X3 Turbo RR 4-Seater.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Can-Am X3 Turbo RR 4-Seater and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Can-Am X3 Turbo RR 4-Seater.

heroPhoto.alt: Red Can-Am Maverick X3 X RS turbo four seater dune buggy on the Dubai red dunes
